subject: Run spike S-3: Claude Code JSON event schema
description:
Establish which `claude -p --output-format json` event types and fields can be depended on for status, session_id capture, and completion signaling. Pin a minimum CC version and document schema stability.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Capture sample JSON event streams from CC across at least 2 recent versions for the same brief.
- [ ] Document the stable subset of event types and fields Capo will rely on (status, session_id, completion).
- [ ] Determine whether session_id arrives in the first event or later, and document the exact field path.
- [ ] Pin a minimum supported CC version that emits the documented stable subset.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Note any events that fire only on error vs. only on success.
- [ ] Note any backwards-incompatible changes observed between versions.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Output: `internal/specs/spikes/S-3-cc-json-schema.md` with event parser spec
• Output: minimum CC version constant for boot-time pre-check

**Output**: Findings document at `internal/specs/spikes/S-3-cc-json-schema.md` and a minimum CC version pin documented in spec §12.1.

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Section 9.0 (Spike S-3)
